scope: Review of the supplied, collected primary evidence; not an exhaustive survey of all publications. Bounded review of the supplied evidence set for Nigeria since 2026-09-13. The provided materials include one news report describing a new voter-preference survey and one country page summarizing Afrobarometer background, but the trusted bindings mark no source IDs as eligible for new evidence in this review. As a result, no new poll record or security-context item can be accepted here. The available evidence also does not supply a qualifying original methodology record with independently supportable publication-date, fieldwork-date, sample, and geography metadata that can be entered under the current rules. Existing national survey context in the bindings may help interpret background, but it is not treated as new evidence in this update.
summary: No material change accepted from the supplied evidence. Published assessments and data dates are unchanged.
